name: ship-resume-kb-gap
title: sd-ship resume enters at Stage 2, which cannot satisfy the KB check Stage 1 owns
description: sd-ship Stage 1 owns the update-spec KB refresh, but a resume with an open PR and nothing to publish enters at Stage 2 by contract, and Stage 2 gates on sd-check whose knowledge.obsidian-kb row requires that refresh. Any resume whose branch changed a KB-copied file therefore blocks on a check only the skipped stage can satisfy, and converges only via an out-of-band manual command. Observed on PR #361 in platypeeps/anomaly-metric-creator. Decide which stage owns the resume-path refresh without duplicating update-spec logic, without a resume acquiring the rest of Stage 1, and without a second refresh on the full-chain path.
creator: sdelmas
